messages:
sam: opened a small docs PR to reconcile /v1/generate examples with OpenAPI and SDKs — saw a few mismatches (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12888)
nora: thanks. which mismatches?
sam: three quick ones: curl/showed `max_tokens` (old name) instead of `max_new_tokens`; response example used `choices` not `outputs`; and one curl example had `X-Request-Id` header casing while SDK snippets use `x-request-id`.
qa: users reported confusion mapping examples to SDKs. the `choices` vs `outputs` thing caused a bug report.
sam: fixed examples in the PR: updated curl/python/go snippets to use `max_new_tokens`, normalized headers to lower-case `x-request-id`, and swapped response example to `outputs: [...]`. also added a short migration note: "If you see `max_tokens` in older examples, use `max_new_tokens` in requests."
docs-bot: lint: fail 
- example param `max_tokens` not in schema for /generate
- response example property `choices` does not match OpenAPI schema
docs-bot: suggestion: update snippets and add changelog entry
nora: please copy the corrected curl and minimal response here so I can verify before merging
sam: corrected curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1","input":"Summarize","max_new_tokens":64}'
```
sam: corrected minimal response shape:
```json
{
  "id": "gen_01X...",
  "model": "redwood/fast-1",
  "outputs": [{"text": "Summary...", "token_count": 60}],
  "usage": {"input_tokens": 10, "output_tokens": 60}
}
```
qa: looks good. please add a tiny snapshot test that asserts example params/response keys and curl header casing to avoid regressions.
sam: created follow-up issue for tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4344 and added a changelog bullet under Docs. rebasing now and will merge once CI passes.
release: noted for release notes: include the migration tip and PR link so integrators can find the mapping quickly. if docs cause CI flake on release branch, revert the sample text temporarily rather than block release.
sam: will do. thanks all :white_check_mark:
